exposure: caesarean section as the mode of delivery
cohort: Women aged 11-59 years delivering at ≥22 gestational weeks in six regions of Italy
finding: The study found a low rate of UR (0.16/1000 pregnancies), with risk factors including maternal age ≥35 years, multiparity, previous cesarean section, uterine scarring, and gestational age <37 weeks.
mod_finding: Cesarean section as the mode of delivery was significantly associated with UR.
